in_marathi.name: Chandraanan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandraanan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chandraanan is derived from Chandra, meaning 'Moon'. The suffix 'anan' means 'God'. This name is a tribute to the Moon God, evoking feelings of peace, tranquility, and divine protection.
